Name: Flareon cat replacement(Content Patcher)
Author: ArcaneDesu
Description:
[b]THESE SPRITES WERE NOT DRAWN BY ME

[/b]Sprites were taken from pokemon mystery dungeon.
I was looking for a flareon cat resprite on nexus to complete my adopt n skin eeveelution group, but I couldn't find one. So like any self-repecting mod author who wants to keep uploading mods, I decided to release the spritesheet I compiled as a mod. Totally not because I'm slacking on Shouko, haha.

Feel free to message me on discord, either on the Stardew Valley discord server or a dm @Arcane#9967.
